Subject: HIPAA + residency pricing and implementation fees

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're evaluating Redwood for a HIPAA-enabled deployment and I need an itemized breakdown for the compliance add-ons so we can budget and prep procurement. Specifically:  

- Audit logs: retention tiers (90d / 1yr / 7yr), expected per-GB storage and egress assumptions, and whether logs are delivered to customer S3 for long-term archival.
- KMS/HSM: options for customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS integration) vs. dedicated HSM seats — pricing model (one-time vs recurring), key limits, and rotation support.
- Data residency: cost delta for US-only vs EU+US residency, and whether cross-region failover is included or billed separately.
- Implementation SOW: one-time onboarding fees for HIPAA readiness (config, SOC attest integrations, attestation checklist), estimated timeline, and whether some tasks are billable vs included in onboarding.
- Discounts: policies for multi-year commitments or committed capacity (we're considering 12–24 month committed throughput).

Can you send a short spreadsheet or bullets with ranges? Procurement will use this to draft an RFP. Also, the security team will push a short questionnaire — happy to share that after you send the pricing. Ideally we have a draft SOW and ballpark numbers by EOD tomorrow so I can share internally.

Hi Samantha — thanks, and great to start this thread. Below is a concise, itemized draft you can pass to procurement. I attached a sample SOW and the Q3 compliance price sheet for reference. Happy to walk through these on a quick call — I proposed Wed 7/21 10am PT below.

Summary - Compliance add-on pricing (draft, subject to final quote and commitment):

1) Audit log retention
- 90 days (included): no incremental charge beyond standard logging (ingest+short-term storage).
- 1 year: $0.03 / GB / month for indexed retention beyond 90d.
- 7 year archival: $0.015 / GB / month for cold tier archival (option to push to customer S3 at no additional movement fee).
- Export to customer S3 (if requested): one-time export config $1,200 + ongoing S3 storage at customer's S3 rates.

2) KMS/HSM options
- Integrated customer-managed KMS (Cloud KMS + Redwood connector): $200 / month per account for key management and rotation tooling; no HSM seat required.
- Dedicated HSM seat (FIPS-140-2 validated appliance or managed HSM tenancy): $3,500 / month per HSM seat (recommended for highest assurance and if customer requires dedicated HSM).
- Key limits: standard package includes up to 10 keys; additional keys $25 / key / month.

3) Data residency
- US-only: baseline.
- EU+US (regional residency + active routing): incremental $0.08 / token-equivalent for traffic routed to EU region due to cross-region replication and standby capacity.
- Cross-region DR testing and failover runbooks are included once per year; additional failover drills are billable at standard TAM rates.

4) Implementation SOW (one-time professional services) — HIPAA readiness + residency setup
- Small deployment (pilot, <5 apps): $12k – $18k (2–4 week engagement).
- Mid deployment (production, up to 50k monthly active users): $30k – $55k (4–8 week engagement).
- Large/enterprise (high-throughput, multi-region): custom SOW; typical range $75k+. Includes runbooks, KMS integration, audit log export, and attestation support.
- Standard deliverables: project plan, network design, KMS integration, audit log configuration, SOC/Security checklist support, knowledge transfer.

5) Discounts and commercial levers
- 12-month commit: standard 10% discount on hosted usage and add-ons (applies to baseline only).
- 24-month commit: 15% discount plus one complimentary HSM seat for first 6 months for contracts >= $250k ARR.
- One-off concessions >15% require RevOps sign-off; anything >25% requires approval from VP Sales.

Next steps
- I attached a sample SOW and the compliance price sheet (see attachments).
- If you can confirm expected commit band (pilot / mid / enterprise) and target execution date, I can produce a draft SOW and formal quote.
- Proposed meeting: Wed, Jul 21, 2027 at 10:00 AM PT — please confirm.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
